query: National Film Centre of Latvia film production incentive rebate official rate 2026
purpose: locate the official government domain for Latvia's National Film Centre incentive program
key_result: identified https://www.nkc.gov.lv/en/cash-rebates as the National Film Centre of Latvia's own official cash-rebates page (nkc.gov.lv = Nacionalais kino centrs)

purpose: retrieve the full, exact, primary-source text of the official Latvian cash-rebate incentive page
excerpt: Support intensity: 30% of eligible costs. Selection rounds: The selection is open for at least 1 month. If funding is available after a closed selection, the Agency announces the next selection round. Decision: 1 month. Applicant: a company registered in Latvia. Main Eligibility Criteria for Foreign Film Project: An agreement with a local production company is required, The film must be fully or partially filmed in Latvia, ... The total production costs must be at least: 711,436 EUR for feature and animation films, 142,287 EUR for documentaries, VAT contributions to the State budget must be at least 50% of the co-financing, The foreign producer must have at least 50% of the total filming costs available, Foreign funding must be at least equal to the eligible costs of the film project in Latvia, Filming must not have started before the project application submission date.
locator: page body, section titled 'INVESTMENT AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF LATVIA / Cash rebate scheme Latvia Co-financing programme for foreign productions'
conclusion: confirms a single flat 30% rate (not a 20/25/30 tiered schedule), with a real deterministic minimum-spend threshold and a set of producer-controlled administrative eligibility criteria; no merit-based/discretionary selection of amount

tool: browser get_page_text (same page, second program block)
purpose: confirm whether the 20-25% figures found in prior low-quality sourcing belong to a DIFFERENT Latvian program, not lv_national_film_centre_incentive
excerpt: THE RIGA FILM FUND OF THE COUNCIL OF RIGA / Cash rebate scheme Riga Film Fund co-financing programme ... Support intensity: 20-25% of eligible costs (25% if the film's story is set in Riga or with significant featuring of Riga in the story, and at least partly shot in Riga, 20% - if the film is shot in the territory of Latvia). Deadlines: open call until 30 September on first come first serve basis until the budget is depleted. ... Annual budget: 800 000 EUR.
locator: page body, section titled 'THE RIGA FILM FUND OF THE COUNCIL OF RIGA'
conclusion: confirms the 20%/25% figures in the prior catalog entry belong to a SEPARATE program (Riga Film Fund, a City of Riga authority, cultural-content-gated), not the National Film Centre's own cash rebate scheme -- the prior catalog entry incorrectly blended the two into one ambiguous tiered structure
